description: Search for people (prospects) by title, seniority, location, company domain or size. Free: the Apollo People API Search consumes no credits. Does NOT return emails or phones — use sdr_waterfall_enrich_person on the people you want. Requires at least one filter. Results are paginated with an opaque `cursor`; pass it back unchanged. Each person carries an apollo id for enrichment. Use sdr_lookup_filters first for exact titles, seniorities and size ranges.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at page 1.

items.description: An employee range like "51,200" (use sdr_lookup_filters kind "employee_range").

name: sdr_search_people
title: Search people
